armySpecialRules.name: DEVA
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Fear, Independent, Magical Attacks, Magical Ward (5+) and Unbreakable special rules.
If a unit of Devas loses a round of close combat it must take an Instability test. This works like a normal Break test, except that for every point they fail the test by, the unit suffers one additional Wound with no saves allowed. The Instability test can be tested on unmodified Leadership if the unit is Stubborn or Steadfast as normal.

armySpecialRules.name: KARMA
armySpecialRules.description:
A unit with this special rule can benefit from either Good Karma or Bad Karma depending on their actions during the game. If a unit has Good Karma and receives Bad Karma or vice versa, the effects cancel each other out.
• Good Karma: If the unit successfully destroys, breaks or panics an enemy unit, all models in it may re-roll 1's To Hit and To Wound in close combat and with missile weapons until they suffer Bad Karma.
• Bad Karma: If the unit breaks from combat or flees as a result of a Panic test, all models in it must re-roll 6's To Hit and To Wound in close combat and with missile weapons until they gain Good Karma.

magicItems.name: MACE OF GODLY MIGHT
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +2 Strength. Roll a D6 for each initial Attack that Hits. On a 4+, it causes another Hit.

magicItems.name: DIVINE THUNDERBOLT
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 6 | Lightning Attacks, Multiple Shots (D3)

magicItems.name: FLAIL OF THE DEATH GODDESS
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 Strength as well as the Armour Piercing (1), Mighty Blow (1) and Poisoned Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: THE PRIMORDIAL SWORD
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains +1 To Hit and +1 To Wound, as well as Flaming Attacks. If they roll a natural 6 when rolling To Wound, the attack is done with the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: TRIDENT OF DESTRUCTION
magicItems.description: All attacks made with this weapon gain the Heroic Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: GAUNTLETS OF THE FIRE LORD
magicItems.description: Every time the wielder inflicts a Hit or makes a Parry save in close combat, they inflict an additional automatic Strength 4 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule against the enemy. In addition, the wearer gains the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: MAHAKALI'S BOW
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 5 | Multiple Wounds (D3), Ignores Armour saves
However, before using it, the wielder must pass a Leadership test or suffer 1 Wound which Ignores Armour Saves instead of being able to shoot with it.

magicItems.name: SHESHA BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gain +D3 Attacks and the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF VICTORY
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Armor Piercing (1) special rule, and will always wound on a roll of 3+, unless they would normally need a lower result. Against models from armies belonging to the Forces of Destruction, it wounds automatically instead.

magicItems.name: THE KAVACHA
magicItems.description: The Kavacha gives the wearer a 2+ armour save, which may be re-rolled. This save cannot be improved by any means.

magicItems.name: KARKADANN ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer gains +1 Toughness and the Immunity (Poisoned Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: ELEPHANT BREASTPLATE
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Impact Hits (D3) and Natural Armour (5+) special rules. In addition, they can reroll failed To Wound rolls with their Impact Hits.

magicItems.name: PADMA ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The wearer can ignore one unsaved Wound per phase by passing a Leadership test using their own unmodified Leadership.

magicItems.name: THE CELESTIAL DIADEM
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a 6+ armour save. In addition, they gain a Magical Ward (4+) against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: SRIVATSA SHIELD
magicItems.description: The wielder starts the game with Good Karma.

magicItems.name: ASHWATHAMA'S GEM
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a Magical Ward (4+) and the Unbreakable special rule. However, they start the game with Bad Karma.

magicItems.name: GARLAND OF VICTORY
magicItems.description: The wearer ignores the first unsaved Wound they suffer. In addition, they add +1 to their Combat resolution.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF SHAMBHALA
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a Magical Ward (6+). In addition, they may re-roll one failed To Hit, To Wound, Armour or Ward Save roll in each phase.

magicItems.name: MAKARA EARRING
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Aquatic, Magical Ward (6+) and Magic Resistance (2) special rules.

magicItems.name: THE STAR JEWEL
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Dodge (5+) special rule, and automatically passed Characteristic tests.

magicItems.name: NECKLACE OF SKULLS
magicItems.description: The wearer gains the Immunity (Killing Blow, Multiple Wounds) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE SUN JEWEL
magicItems.description: The bearer gains a +1 casting and dispelling bonus. If they have Good Karma and Miscast, they may ignore the roll on the miscast table on a D6 roll of 4+. However, if they have Bad Karma, they will Miscast on any roll of any double, instead of just double 1's.

magicItems.name: THE WISH GEM
magicItems.description: Choose one spell from any of the eight Winds of Magic and roll a D3. If the roll is higher than the Spell Level (Signature Spells counts as Level 1), it is automatically cast with a power level equal to the normal casting value of the spell, no power dice are required.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF BRAHAMBHU
magicItems.description: This item contains a magic missile with a range of 24" that causes 2D6 Strength 5 Hits with the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: ORB OF THE DEVA
magicItems.description: This item may be used before casting a spell. If successfully cast, the spell cannot be dispelled. However, if the spell does not reach its minimum casting value, the spell counts as a Miscast.

magicItems.name: SKULL-CUP OF TRANSCENDENCE
magicItems.description: Before each attempt to cast a spell, the bearer may take a Leadership test using their own unmodified characteristic. If passed, they gain a +1 casting bonus this turn until they fail to cast a spell or their casting attempt is dispelled. The bonus is cumulative.

magicItems.name: NECTAR OF THE GODS
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any phase. When used, the bearer regains all lost Wounds and gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule until the start of your next turn.

magicItems.name: MASK OF GOOD FORTUNE
magicItems.description: The wearer of this mask may re-roll failed rolls of 1 when rolling To Hit, To Wound, and when taking armour saves and invulnerable saves.

magicItems.name: BLESSED ANKUSHA
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Cold-Blooded special rule when taking Stampede tests, and can reroll 1's when determining the number of Impact Hits.

magicItems.name: SHANKHA SHELL HORN
magicItems.description: The bearer may use this item at the beginning of your Close Combat phase. For the remainder of the turn, all friendly units within 12" of the bearer gains the Devastating Charge special rule.

magicItems.name: PARIJATA WREATH
magicItems.description: The bearer's characteristics (except Leadership) can never be lowered from their starting value during the course of the game.

magicItems.name: PRAYER BEADS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gain +1 Leadership when using Prayers of the Deva.

magicItems.name: HOLY STANDARD OF THE DEVAS
magicItems.description: All models in the unit carrying this banner gain a Magical Ward (5+) and the Stubborn special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF DIVINE INCANDESCENCE
magicItems.description: Enemies suffer -1 To Hit with missile weapons against the unit carrying this magic standard. In addition, all models in base contact with the standard suffer a Strength 4 Hit with the Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules at the beginning of each Close Combat phase. This is increased to Strength 5 against Daemons, Undead and Vampires.

magicItems.name: MARUTVANT BANNER
magicItems.description: Whenever a model in the unit carrying this standard rolls a natural 6 To Wound, that Attack has the Lightning Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: PENNANT OF ENDURING KARMA
magicItems.description: When the unit carrying this magic standard receives Bad Karma, roll a D6; on a 2+, the the Bad Karma is ignored.

magicItems.name: TOTEM OF BRAHAMBHU
magicItems.description: Enemies do not receive any combat resolution bonuses for attacking the flanks or rear of the unit carrying this standard.
